title: Traditional ANZAC Biscuits
description: A classic Australian favourite — golden, chewy, and steeped in history. Now with desiccated coconut and brown sugar for deeper flavour.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 160°C. Line baking trays with paper.
Combine flour, oats, coconut, brown sugar, and caster sugar in a large bowl.
In a small saucepan, melt butter, golden syrup, and water over low heat until butter is melted.
Stir in bi-carb soda — the mixture will foam up.
Pour wet mixture into dry ingredients and stir until well combined.
Roll tablespoons of mixture into 35g balls. Place on trays 8cm apart and flatten slightly.
Bake for 18-20 minutes until golden brown.
Cool on trays for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. They will firm up as they cool.

notes.title: Brown Sugar
notes.content: Brown sugar adds moisture and a deeper caramel flavour. The combination of brown and caster sugar gives the perfect balance of chew and crisp.

notes.title: Double Batch
notes.content: For 48 biscuits, double all ingredients. Bake for 20-22 minutes, rotating trays halfway.

notes.title: Storage
notes.content: Store in an airtight container. They will keep for up to 2 weeks — if they last that long.
